notes: DOMAIN: laredoute.fr (France, French UI, EUR) - NOT laredoute.co.uk, which carries SR 82 La Redoute UK and SR 278 La Redoute Interiors UK. SCOPE: 'La Redoute Interieurs' (LRI) is La Redoute's in-house exclusive home/furniture brand sold through the general laredoute.fr marketplace, so - exactly as in the prior Home-Decor pass on this company (archive c106) - every row is the LRI house-brand subset of a laredoute.fr Maison category, captured with the site's own brand filter ?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs. Fashion/apparel departments (Mode femme/homme, Enfant-bebe clothing) were not touched. ACCESS: direct fetch, curl_cffi (chrome131/124/edge101/safari18_0/safari18_0_ios) and every desktop profile return the Cloudflare 'Country challenge' 403 interstitial documented in the prior pass. The working route this time was a plain requests GET with the Googlebot user-agent - it returns HTTP 200 and the full prerendered PLP on www.laredoute.fr, m.laredoute.fr, laredoute.be and laredoute.com. robots.txt was checked first: no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive, and none of the /pplp/ category paths are disallowed. TREE: built from https://www.laredoute.fr/sitemap-categories.xml (2264 category URLs, served unprotected) restricted to the Maison root 75363 plus all flat /pplp/cat-N.aspx nodes (648 pages fetched), then re-rooted onto the site's CURRENT navigation using the BreadCrumbDetail JSON embedded in every PLP (the legacy /pplp/100/75363/158092/... URL path is an older taxonomy and does NOT match today's menu; the breadcrumb does). The furniture departments in the live Maison mega-menu are 'Canape, fauteuil' (385993), 'Table, chaise' (385998), 'Meuble' (75363), 'Lit, literie' (75326) and 'Mobilier de jardin' (75067). 'Achetez par piece' (392588 - shop by room) was skipped as duplicative room landing pages that publish no counts. QTY METHOD: the rendered listing header, <span id="ProductCount"> immediately after the h1, on the brand-filtered URL. Verified exact by full enumeration on cat-75506 (header 4 = 4 unique /ppdp/prod- ids = 4 tiles) and on nine further nodes where paging to the true end gave unique-id counts identical to the header every time (24, 27, 25, 37, 25, 31, 34, 15, 189). Re-read four leaves (Canape 492, Lit 204, Armoire-dressing 163, Chaise-fauteuil-banc de jardin 46) later in the session - no drift. BRAND-FILTER VERIFICATION: for every leaf the rendered <title> was required to end in 'LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS'; a control with ?brndid=zzz-nonsense-brand leaves both title and count unchanged (e.g. cat-75397: 150 filtered vs 1222 unfiltered vs 1222 nonsense). Nine furniture nodes silently ignored the LRI filter (count identical to unfiltered, title unsuffixed): BZ 75385, Clic-clac 75387, Fauteuil club 75470, Fauteuil relax 75471, Table enfant 385999, Plan a langer 285531, Balancelle de jardin 75110, Armoire/etagere de jardin 253813, Pouf exterieur 389591. Rather than report the unfiltered totals I enumerated all nine to the true end (unique product ids equalled the site total in every case) and scanned every product title: ZERO La Redoute Interieurs items in any of them. On 389591 a control brand (?brndid=atmosphera) filtered correctly to 4 with a suffixed title, proving the node supports brand filtering and that La Redoute falls back to the unfiltered listing when the requested brand has no match. Those nine are therefore genuine LRI zeros and are omitted rather than reported. ENGLISH NAMES: taken from La Redoute's own English storefront (laredoute.co.uk shares the same category node ids, e.g. cat-75503 = 'Coffee Tables', cat-386008 = 'Wardrobes & Clothes Storage'). Where the UK site has repurposed a node under a different commercial label (75399 'Ready Made Sofas', 75403 'Made To Order Sofas', 75470 'Made To Order Armchairs', 75469 'Ready Made Armchairs') the faithful translation of the French node name was used instead (Straight Sofas, Chaise Longues, Living Room Armchairs). Nodes absent from the UK site were translated directly and checked against the actual product titles on the page (e.g. 386010 Vestiaire = hallway coat units, 75436 Dressing = walk-in wardrobe modules, 75395 Mobilier de bureau = desk pedestals/office storage, 155574 Tiroir de lit = under-bed drawers, 75468 Chauffeuse = armless/modular chairs). EXCLUDED and why: mattresses and the whole Literie side of 75326 (Matelas, Surmatelas, Sommier and its bed-base children, Couette, Oreiller, Alese, Ensemble matelas et sommier) - bedding, not furniture, per the brief; Echantillons de tissus 75402 (fabric swatches); Galette/housse de chaise 385862, Housse de canape 84112, Housse de rangement 75489 (covers); Cintre, amenagement dressing 75432 (hangers/fittings); Porte-serviettes, sechoir 75498 (bathroom accessory); Malle/coffre de rangement 75488 and Coffre de jardin 75112 (standalone storage trunks/boxes); Abri de jardin 75069 (garden shed); Rangement cuisine 75442 and Rangement deco 385420 (storage goods); Barbecue/plancha/brasero, Piscine-spa, Parasol-pergola-store, Brise-vue, Luminaire exterieur, Decoration jardin, Coussin/Tapis d'exterieur, Pot-bac-jardiniere (all non-furniture garden lines); Luminaire 75474, Decoration 75443, Art de la table 75364, Tapis 75509 and Linge de maison 84100 (lighting, decor, tableware, rugs, textiles - other tasks); 'Nouveautes' nodes 385997/386003/353742 (new-arrival landing pages, section 3). AM.PM (85201) and 'Seconde vie' (300731) mirror the same furniture tree but are a DIFFERENT La Redoute house brand and a second-hand marketplace respectively, so they were left out of this LRI-scoped extraction. ONE FLAGGED ROW: Room Dividers and Screens (Paravent 75459, 2 items) - freestanding folding screens; the site files the node under Decoration > Rangement deco rather than under its Furniture department, so it is included with a MANUAL REVIEW flag.
